title: File:-ChefsforJamaica- Providing relief after Hurricane Melissa.jpg
desc: WCK is on the ground in various areas of Jamaica to provide comforting food and supplies to communities impacted by the destructive, harsh Hurricane Melissa. Homes were destroyed and power was cut in many areas.
